title: bb_edit: integration tests (edit + index + freshness + reindex)

checks.name: TS: old symbol no longer resolves post-rename
TS: on-disk content has the new name
Python: on-disk content has the new name
Java: on-disk content has the new name
failed edit: keyword rename aborts (no half-reindex) [negative: validation failed]
failed edit: file content restored to pre-edit
failed edit: index still fresh to the unchanged file
failed edit: original symbol still resolves (no half-reindex)
insert: on-disk content has the inserted line

decisions.loop: executeEdit writes -> validateFile -> reindexFilesParallel; a successful edit must leave the index fresh and reflecting the new name
decisions.failConsistency: a failed edit (validation error) rolls back files; the index is not reindexed, so the pre-edit index stays consistent with the rolled-back files

limitations: The loop is verified at the brain_file/brain_symbol freshness level; full embedding regeneration is async and verified separately in.
